shipped.example: TechHub has shipped the order you placed on Thursday.
shipped.example_cn: TechHub 已经寄出了你周四下的订单。
altExamples: The artifacts were carefully shipped to the museum in climate-controlled containers to prevent any damage.
Once the laboratory equipment is shipped, researchers expect to begin their experiments within two weeks.
altExamples_cn: 这些文物被小心地装在恒温容器中运往博物馆，以防损坏。
一旦实验室设备运到，研究人员预计将在两周内开始实验。

shoppers.example: In an experiment, psychologist Sheena Iyengar found that shoppers were more likely to purchase jam when offered 6 varieties instead of 24.
shoppers.example_cn: 在一项实验中，心理学家 Sheena Iyengar 发现，购物者在面对 6 种果酱时比面对 24 种时更有可能购买。
altExamples: During the holiday season, shoppers tend to spend more money on electronics and luxury goods.
Online shoppers are increasingly influenced by product reviews and ratings posted by previous customers.
altExamples_cn: 节假日期间，购物者往往在电子产品和奢侈品上花费更多。
网购者越来越受到之前顾客发布的产品评价和评分的影响。

showcasing.example: Some Roman aqueducts, like the Pont du Gard in France, are still standing today, showcasing the Romans' remarkable engineering skills.
showcasing.example_cn: 一些罗马引水渠，如法国的加尔桥，至今仍然屹立，展示了罗马人非凡的工程技艺。
altExamples: The museum's new exhibition is showcasing rare fossils discovered in the region over the past decade.
The conference provides a platform for showcasing innovative research in renewable energy technologies from around the world.
altExamples_cn: 博物馆的新展览正在展示过去十年间在该地区发现的稀有化石。
该会议为展示全球可再生能源技术的创新研究提供了平台。

signings.example: / Town Square Enjoy author signings, book readings, and literary workshops.
signings.example_cn: Town Square 广场：尽享作家签售、读书会和文学工作坊。
altExamples: Book signings by prominent authors often attract large crowds of enthusiastic readers and collectors.
The gallery will host signings by several emerging artists following the opening reception this weekend.
altExamples_cn: 知名作家的签售会常常吸引大批热情的读者和收藏家。
画廊将在本周末的开幕招待会后举办多位新锐艺术家的签售活动。

sitcoms.example: Sitcoms reflecting everyday life, like I Love Lucy, became a cultural phenomenon.
sitcoms.example_cn: 反映日常生活的情景喜剧，如《我爱露西》，成为一种文化现象。
altExamples: American sitcoms from the 1990s often explored themes of friendship, family dynamics, and workplace relationships.
The structure of sitcoms typically relies on recurring characters and humorous situations to maintain viewer engagement.
altExamples_cn: 20 世纪 90 年代的美国情景喜剧常常探讨友谊、家庭关系和职场人际关系等主题。
情景喜剧的结构通常依靠固定角色和幽默情境来维持观众的参与感。

slot.example: Title: Library Computer Reservation System Library Card Number: Computer Station Preference: □ Basic (Internet only) □ Premium (Full software access) Time Slot: □ 9-11 A.
slot.example_cn: 标题：图书馆电脑预约系统  图书卡号：  电脑工作站偏好：□ 基础版（仅限上网）□ 高级版（全套软件访问） 时间段：□ 上午 9-11 点
altExamples: Each conference participant was assigned a thirty-minute time slot to present their research findings.
The memory slot on the motherboard can be expanded to accommodate additional RAM modules for better performance.
altExamples_cn: 每位会议参与者被分配了三十分钟的时间段来展示他们的研究成果。
主板上的内存插槽可以扩展，以容纳额外的内存条，从而提升性能。

smock.example: All necessary arts supplies will be provided, but please bring your own apron or smock.
smock.example_cn: 所有必要的绘画用品都将提供，但请自带围裙或工作罩衫。
altExamples: The artist carefully put on her smock before beginning work on the large canvas mural.
Laboratory technicians are required to wear protective smocks to avoid contaminating sensitive experimental samples.
altExamples_cn: 艺术家在开始绘制大幅画布壁画前，仔细地穿上了工作罩衫。
实验室技术人员必须穿戴防护工作服，以避免污染敏感的实验样本。

soccer.example: For example, community soccer leagues often bring together people from different ethnicities, creating an environment where cultural differences are celebrated and mutual respect is cultivated.
soccer.example_cn: 例如，社区足球联赛常常将不同族裔的人聚集在一起，营造出一个文化差异受到赞颂、相互尊重得以培养的环境。
altExamples: Soccer has become a global phenomenon that transcends cultural boundaries and unites people from diverse backgrounds.
Participation in youth soccer programs has been linked to improved physical health and social skill development.
altExamples_cn: 足球已经成为一种超越文化边界、将不同背景的人们团结在一起的全球现象。
参与青少年足球项目与改善身体健康和社交技能发展有关联。

sofia.example: username：Sofia Baker Every Saturday, our local farmer's market is the place to be!
sofia.example_cn: 用户名：Sofia Baker  每周六，我们当地的农贸市场是最值得去的地方！
altExamples: Sofia's research on marine biodiversity earned her a prestigious fellowship at the oceanographic institute.
Dr. Sofia Ramirez published a groundbreaking paper on the relationship between gut microbiota and cognitive function.
altExamples_cn: Sofia 在海洋生物多样性方面的研究为她赢得了海洋研究所的著名奖学金。
Sofia Ramirez 博士发表了一篇关于肠道微生物群与认知功能关系的开创性论文。

soothing.example: This is why workout playlists often feature upbeat songs, while relaxation playlists include soothing melodies.
soothing.example_cn: 这就是为什么运动歌单通常收录欢快的歌曲，而放松歌单则包含舒缓的旋律。
altExamples: The soothing sound of rainfall creates an atmosphere conducive to concentration and deep intellectual work.
Certain soothing colors in classroom environments have been shown to reduce student anxiety during examinations.
altExamples_cn: 舒缓的雨声营造出有利于集中注意力和进行深度脑力工作的氛围。
研究表明，教室环境中某些舒缓的颜色可以减轻学生考试期间的焦虑。

altExamples: Sophia's dissertation on medieval trade routes received commendation from the history department faculty members.
Architect Sophia Torres designed the building to maximize natural light while minimizing energy consumption.
altExamples_cn: Sophia 关于中世纪贸易路线的论文获得了历史系教师的嘉奖。
建筑师 Sophia Torres 设计了该建筑，以最大限度地利用自然光，同时最大限度地减少能源消耗。

sought.example: Advertisers sought to influence content to appeal to mass audiences, which sometimes clashed with creative visions.
sought.example_cn: 广告商试图影响内容以迎合大众受众，这有时与创意愿景发生冲突。
altExamples: Many ancient scholars sought knowledge by traveling great distances to study at renowned centers of learning.
The committee sought input from industry experts before finalizing the new curriculum standards for engineering programs.
altExamples_cn: 许多古代学者长途跋涉，前往著名的学术中心求学，以寻求知识。
委员会在最终确定工程项目的新课程标准之前，征求了行业专家的意见。

southward.example: In the northern hemisphere, when the jet stream dips southward, it brings cold air and storms to lower latitudes.
southward.example_cn: 在北半球，当急流向南倾斜时，会将冷空气和风暴带到低纬度地区。
altExamples: The migration patterns of monarch butterflies shift southward as temperatures drop in the autumn months.
The river flows southward through several countries before emptying into the Mediterranean Sea.
altExamples_cn: 随着秋季气温下降，帝王蝶的迁徙路线向南转移。
这条河向南流经多个国家，最终注入地中海。

spaces.example: Initiatives such as creating urban green spaces, constructing bird-friendly buildings, and reducing light pollution are being implemented.
spaces.example_cn: 打造城市绿地、建造对鸟类友好的建筑、减少光污染等举措正在实施中。
altExamples: Architects are increasingly designing flexible workspaces that can be reconfigured for different collaborative activities.
The preservation of natural spaces within city limits contributes significantly to residents' quality of life.
altExamples_cn: 建筑师越来越多地设计灵活的工作空间，可以根据不同的协作活动重新配置。
保护城市范围内的自然空间对居民的生活质量有显著贡献。

spar.example: Some argue the sagas' content is mythical, while others suggest these stones were real tools used by the Vikings, probably crystals, such as Iceland spar.
spar.example_cn: 有人认为这些传奇故事的内容是神话，而另一些人则认为这些石头是维京人使用的真实工具，很可能是晶体，比如冰洲石。
altExamples: Iceland spar, a transparent form of calcite, exhibits the optical property of double refraction when light passes through.
Geologists use spar crystals to identify the mineral composition of rock formations in sedimentary environments.
altExamples_cn: 冰洲石是方解石的一种透明形式，当光线穿过时表现出双折射的光学特性。
地质学家利用晶石晶体来识别沉积环境中岩层的矿物成分。

sparrows.example: Some species, such as pigeons and sparrows, have adapted well to urban environments, taking advantage of the new resources and structures.
sparrows.example_cn: 一些物种，如鸽子和麻雀，已经很好地适应了城市环境，充分利用了新的资源和建筑结构。
altExamples: Sparrows have adapted remarkably well to urban environments, nesting in buildings and feeding on human food waste.
The decline of sparrow populations in cities has been linked to reduced availability of insect food sources.
altExamples_cn: 麻雀对城市环境的适应能力极强，它们在建筑物中筑巢，以人类食物垃圾为食。
城市麻雀数量的减少与昆虫食物来源的减少有关。

spatial.example: Cognitive mapping is a term used to describe the mental process by which humans and animals acquire, code, store, recall, and decode information about their spatial environment.
spatial.example_cn: 认知地图是一个术语，用于描述人类和动物获取、编码、存储、回忆和解码有关其空间环境信息的心理过程。
altExamples: Children develop spatial reasoning skills through activities that involve constructing models and solving puzzles.
The brain's hippocampus plays a critical role in forming spatial memories and navigating familiar environments.
altExamples_cn: 儿童通过搭建模型和解决谜题等活动来发展空间推理能力。
大脑的海马体在形成空间记忆和在熟悉环境中导航方面起着关键作用。

spectators.example: Spectatorship and fandom also play significant roles in uniting people.
spectators.example_cn: 观众身份和粉丝文化在团结人们方面也发挥着重要作用。
altExamples: Thousands of spectators gathered in the stadium to witness the final match of the championship tournament.
The behavior of spectators at sporting events can influence the performance of athletes competing on the field.
altExamples_cn: 成千上万的观众聚集在体育场，观看锦标赛的决赛。
体育赛事中观众的行为会影响场上运动员的表现。

spectatorship.example: Spectatorship and fandom also play significant roles in uniting people.
spectatorship.example_cn: 观众身份和粉丝文化在团结人们方面也发挥着重要作用。
altExamples: The concept of spectatorship in modern media extends beyond passive viewing to include interactive audience participation.
Scholars have analyzed spectatorship as a cultural practice that shapes collective identity and social belonging.
altExamples_cn: 现代媒体中观众身份的概念已从被动观看扩展到包含互动式受众参与。
学者们将观众身份分析为一种塑造集体认同和社会归属感的文化实践。

splitting.example: [B] It polarizes light by splitting light into two beams, creating a double image when the stone is held up to the sky.
splitting.example_cn: 它通过将光分成两束来使光偏振，当把石头举向天空时会产生双重图像。
altExamples: Cell division begins with the splitting of chromosomes during the mitotic phase of the eukaryotic cell cycle.
Political parties often face internal conflict over splitting resources between competing policy priorities and initiatives.
altExamples_cn: 细胞分裂始于真核细胞周期有丝分裂阶段染色体的分离。
政党常常在相互竞争的政策优先事项和倡议之间分配资源时面临内部冲突。

sportswear.example: Here's to a smoother launch of the water bottle than of the smart sportswear line!
sportswear.example_cn: 希望水瓶的发布比智能运动服装系列更顺利！
altExamples: The sportswear industry has experienced substantial growth due to increasing consumer interest in health and fitness.
Sustainable sportswear made from recycled materials is gaining popularity among environmentally conscious consumers.
altExamples_cn: 由于消费者对健康和健身的兴趣日益增长，运动服装行业经历了大幅增长。
由回收材料制成的可持续运动服装在环保意识强的消费者中越来越受欢迎。

stall.example: Their stall is always bustling with customers eager to buy fresh, pesticide-free vegetables from the welcoming staff.
stall.example_cn: 他们的摊位总是熙熙攘攘，顾客热切地从热情的员工那里购买新鲜、无农药的蔬菜。
altExamples: The market stall offered an impressive variety of fresh produce sourced from local organic farms.
Negotiations between the two countries threaten to stall unless both parties agree to compromise on tariffs.
altExamples_cn: 市场摊位提供种类繁多的新鲜农产品，均来自当地有机农场。
除非双方就关税问题达成妥协，否则两国之间的谈判有停滞的风险。

static.example: Moreover, cognitive maps are not static; they evolve with new experiences and information.
static.example_cn: 此外，认知地图并非静态的；它们随着新的经验和信息而演变。
altExamples: The static image on the screen failed to capture the dynamic nature of the cellular process.
Unlike static models, dynamic simulations allow economists to observe how variables change over time periods.
altExamples_cn: 屏幕上的静态图像未能捕捉到细胞过程的动态特性。
与静态模型不同，动态模拟允许经济学家观察变量在不同时间段的变化。

statues.example: Roman theater borrowed from Greek precedents but introduced new elements like elaborate stage designs including, for example, statues of heroes or portraits of the imperial family.
statues.example_cn: 罗马戏剧借鉴了古希腊的先例，但引入了新的元素，如精心设计的舞台布景，包括英雄雕像或皇室肖像。
altExamples: The ancient Greeks carved marble statues that captured the idealized human form with remarkable anatomical precision.
Public statues erected in city squares often serve as symbols of national identity and historical memory.
altExamples_cn: 古希腊人雕刻的大理石雕像以卓越的解剖学精度捕捉了理想化的人体形态。
城市广场上竖立的公共雕像通常作为国家认同和历史记忆的象征。

stones.example: [A] One key to their navigational success may have been the use of so-called "sunstones," as described in Icelandic sagas (medieval Icelandic texts).
stones.example_cn: 他们导航成功的一个关键可能是使用了所谓的「太阳石」，如冰岛传奇（中世纪冰岛文本）中所描述的。
altExamples: Geologists classify stones based on their mineral composition, hardness, and crystalline structure.
The ancient pathway was paved with smooth stones that had been worn down by centuries of foot traffic.
altExamples_cn: 地质学家根据矿物成分、硬度和晶体结构对石头进行分类。
古老的小路由光滑的石头铺成，这些石头已经被几个世纪的脚步磨平了。

strive.example: We appreciate your understanding as we strive to ensure the security and reliability of our IT infrastructure.
strive.example_cn: 感谢您的理解，我们正在努力确保 IT 基础设施的安全性和可靠性。
altExamples: Many developing nations strive to achieve economic independence by diversifying their industrial production sectors.
Scientists continue to strive for a deeper understanding of dark matter and its role in the universe.
altExamples_cn: 许多发展中国家努力通过多元化工业生产部门来实现经济独立。
科学家们继续努力寻求对暗物质及其在宇宙中作用的更深入理解。

submission.example: Ensure all testing is complete before submission.
submission.example_cn: 确保在提交前完成所有测试。
altExamples: The deadline for manuscript submission to the peer-reviewed journal is the last day of the month.
Submission of the grant proposal requires careful attention to the formatting guidelines provided by the funding agency.
altExamples_cn: 向同行评审期刊提交稿件的截止日期是本月最后一天。
提交资助申请需要仔细遵守资助机构提供的格式指南。

substances.example: They used substances like honey and willow bark to treat ailments.
substances.example_cn: 他们使用蜂蜜和柳树皮等物质来治疗疾病。
altExamples: Toxic substances released from industrial waste can contaminate groundwater supplies for decades.
The laboratory is equipped to analyze the chemical composition of unknown substances using spectroscopy techniques.
altExamples_cn: 工业废料释放的有毒物质可以污染地下水供应达数十年之久。
实验室配备了光谱分析技术来分析未知物质的化学成分。

substandard.example: Housing was often substandard, and sanitation issues were prevalent.
substandard.example_cn: 住房往往不合标准，卫生问题普遍存在。
altExamples: The inspector condemned the substandard wiring in the ancient building as a serious fire hazard.
Students receiving substandard education often struggle to compete in the global job market.
altExamples_cn: 检查员认定这座古建筑中不合格的电线是严重的火灾隐患。
接受低标准教育的学生往往难以在全球就业市场中竞争。

subtropical.example: Vibrio species thrive in warm, salty environments, making them particularly prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions.
subtropical.example_cn: 弧菌属物种在温暖、咸水环境中繁殖旺盛，因此在热带和亚热带地区尤为常见。
altExamples: Many citrus fruits flourish in the subtropical climate of coastal Mediterranean regions.
The subtropical wetlands support an extraordinary diversity of bird and reptile species.
altExamples_cn: 许多柑橘类水果在地中海沿岸地区的亚热带气候中茁壮成长。
亚热带湿地养育了种类繁多的鸟类和爬行动物。

sunstone.example: [A] One key to their navigational success may have been the use of so-called "sunstones," as described in Icelandic sagas (medieval Icelandic texts).
sunstone.example_cn: 他们导航成功的一个关键可能是使用了所谓的「太阳石」，如冰岛传奇（中世纪冰岛文本）中所描述的。
altExamples: Medieval sailors allegedly used sunstones to locate the sun's position on overcast days.
Geologists have identified Iceland spar as the most likely candidate for the legendary Viking sunstone.
altExamples_cn: 据称，中世纪的水手使用太阳石在阴天确定太阳的位置。
地质学家已确定冰洲石是传说中的维京太阳石最可能的候选物。

supervising.example: • Responsibilities include leading nature walks, supervising craft activities, and helping with educational demonstrations.
supervising.example_cn: 职责包括带领自然徒步、督导手工活动以及协助教育演示。
altExamples: The senior researcher spent the afternoon supervising the laboratory assistants during the experiment.
Supervising doctoral candidates requires balancing guidance with allowing independent intellectual exploration.
altExamples_cn: 资深研究员花了整个下午在实验过程中指导实验室助理。
指导博士生需要在提供引导与允许独立学术探索之间取得平衡。

supervisors.example: We have also collected comments from supervisors and colleagues, based on which you will receive constructive feedback.
supervisors.example_cn: 我们还收集了主管和同事的评论，基于这些评论你将收到建设性的反馈。
altExamples: Effective supervisors communicate expectations clearly and provide constructive feedback to their teams.
The interns presented their findings to the supervisors at the end of the six-week program.
altExamples_cn: 高效的主管会清晰地传达期望并向团队提供建设性的反馈。
实习生在为期六周的项目结束时向主管们展示了他们的研究成果。

supplied.example: The Romans, in particular, mastered the construction of aqueducts, building extensive networks that supplied water to urban centers.
supplied.example_cn: 罗马人尤其精通引水渠的建造，修建了庞大的管网向城市中心供水。
altExamples: The humanitarian organization supplied essential medical equipment to the underfunded rural clinic.
Ancient aqueducts supplied fresh water to bathhouses, fountains, and private residences throughout the empire.
altExamples_cn: 人道主义组织向资金不足的乡村诊所提供了必要的医疗设备。
古代引水渠将淡水输送到帝国各地的浴场、喷泉和私人住宅。

surgical.example: One significant contribution of Egyptian medicine was surgical techniques.
surgical.example_cn: 埃及医学的一个重要贡献是外科技术。
altExamples: The development of antiseptic techniques dramatically reduced mortality rates in surgical procedures.
Modern surgical robots allow for unprecedented precision in minimally invasive operations.
altExamples_cn: 无菌技术的发展大大降低了外科手术的死亡率。
现代手术机器人使微创手术的精度达到了前所未有的水平。

sustainability.example: Organic farming often yields lower outputs than conventional methods, complicating the balance between sustainability and food security.
sustainability.example_cn: 有机农业的产量通常低于传统方法，这使得可持续性与粮食安全之间的平衡变得更加复杂。
altExamples: Urban planners increasingly prioritize sustainability when designing public transportation systems for growing cities.
The conference focused on sustainability strategies for reducing carbon emissions in the manufacturing sector.
altExamples_cn: 城市规划者在为不断发展的城市设计公共交通系统时，越来越重视可持续性。
会议重点讨论了制造业减少碳排放的可持续发展战略。

swap.example: Learn a new language, meet people from different cultural backgrounds, and swap languages in a fun, flexible, and relaxed way.
swap.example_cn: 学习一门新语言，结识来自不同文化背景的人，并以有趣、灵活、轻松的方式交换语言。
altExamples: Participants in the language program swap conversation time between their native tongue and the target language.
Scientists often swap data and methodologies to accelerate progress in collaborative research projects.
altExamples_cn: 语言项目的参与者用母语和目标语言交换对话时间。
科学家们经常交换数据和方法论，以加快合作研究项目的进展。

synthetic.example: Organic farming avoids synthetic pesticides and fertilizers, focusing on crop rotation, composting, and biological pest control.
synthetic.example_cn: 有机农业避免使用合成杀虫剂和化肥，注重轮作、堆肥和生物防治害虫。
altExamples: Synthetic polymers have revolutionized the textile industry due to their durability and low cost.
Some synthetic fertilizers provide immediate nutrients to crops but may degrade soil quality over time.
altExamples_cn: 合成聚合物因其耐用性和低成本彻底改变了纺织工业。
一些合成肥料能为作物提供速效养分，但随着时间的推移可能会降低土壤质量。

tables.example: Our outdoor area includes a playground and picnic tables, which can be set up to your preference.
tables.example_cn: 我们的户外区域包括一个游乐场和野餐桌，可按您的喜好布置。
altExamples: The researchers compiled their experimental results into tables for clearer statistical comparison.
Picnic tables provide a communal space for visitors to enjoy meals in the park.
altExamples_cn: 研究人员将实验结果编制成表格，以便更清晰地进行统计比较。
野餐桌为游客在公园中享用餐饮提供了公共空间。

talbot.example: The invention of the calotype by William Henry Fox Talbot in the 1840s allowed for multiple copies of an image to be made from a single negative, revolutionizing the field.
talbot.example_cn: William Henry Fox Talbot 在 19 世纪 40 年代发明的卡罗式摄影法使得从一张底片中可以制作出多张图像副本，彻底改变了该领域。
altExamples: Talbot's calotype process enabled photographers to produce multiple positive prints from a single negative.
The contributions of Talbot to early photography are frequently compared to those of Daguerre in France.
altExamples_cn: Talbot 的卡罗式摄影法使摄影师能够从一张底片制作多张正片印相。
Talbot 对早期摄影的贡献常常与法国的 Daguerre 相提并论。

altExamples: Professor Tanaka delivered a compelling lecture on the economic history of postwar Japan.
Tanaka's research on marine biology has been cited extensively in recent oceanography publications.
altExamples_cn: Tanaka 教授就战后日本经济史发表了一场引人入胜的演讲。
Tanaka 在海洋生物学方面的研究在近期的海洋学出版物中被广泛引用。

techhub.example: TechHub has shipped the order you placed on Thursday.
techhub.example_cn: TechHub 已经寄出了你周四下的订单。
altExamples: The city transformed itself into a major techhub by attracting startups with tax incentives.
As a thriving techhub, the region offers abundant networking opportunities for entrepreneurs.
altExamples_cn: 该城市通过税收优惠吸引初创企业，将自己转变为一个重要的科技中心。
作为一个蓬勃发展的科技中心，该地区为企业家提供了丰富的社交机会。

technician.example: Our technician will visit your apartment on June 10th between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM.
technician.example_cn: 我们的技术人员将于 6 月 10 日下午 1:00 至 3:00 之间到访您的公寓。
altExamples: The laboratory technician calibrated the microscope before the research team began their analysis.
A skilled technician can diagnose equipment malfunctions more efficiently than automated systems.
altExamples_cn: 实验室技术人员在研究团队开始分析之前校准了显微镜。
熟练的技术人员比自动化系统能更有效地诊断设备故障。

technological.example: The history of photography is marked by significant technological progress and artistic innovation.
technological.example_cn: 摄影史以重大的技术进步和艺术创新为标志。
altExamples: Technological innovations in renewable energy have significantly reduced the cost of solar panels.
The rapid pace of technological change poses challenges for educational institutions updating curricula.
altExamples_cn: 可再生能源领域的技术创新显著降低了太阳能电池板的成本。
技术变革的快速步伐给教育机构更新课程带来了挑战。

tempera.example: Because oil paints dry more slowly than tempera paints, artists could use blending and layering to create more texture and richer colors.
tempera.example_cn: 由于油画颜料比蛋彩画颜料干得慢，艺术家可以利用调和与叠加创造出更多的质感和更丰富的色彩。
altExamples: Tempera paint dries quickly, making it suitable for artists who prefer to work in layers.
Before the Renaissance, tempera was the primary medium for panel painting throughout Europe.
altExamples_cn: 蛋彩画颜料干得快，适合喜欢分层作画的艺术家。
在文艺复兴之前，蛋彩画是整个欧洲木板画的主要媒介。

temporarily.example: During this window, access to network drives and cloud storage services will be temporarily unavailable.
temporarily.example_cn: 在此期间，网络驱动器和云存储服务的访问将暂时不可用。
altExamples: The museum will temporarily close its main exhibition hall to complete necessary structural repairs and upgrades.
Due to budget constraints, the program was temporarily suspended until additional funding could be secured.
altExamples_cn: 博物馆将暂时关闭主展厅，以完成必要的结构维修和升级。
由于预算限制，该计划被暂停，直至获得额外资金。

tempos.example: Fast-paced music can energize us, while slower tempos can calm us down.
tempos.example_cn: 快节奏的音乐能让我们充满活力，而较慢的速度能让我们平静下来。
altExamples: Composers use varying tempos to evoke different emotional responses from their audiences.
The conductor adjusted the tempos throughout the symphony to create dramatic tension.
altExamples_cn: 作曲家使用不同的速度来唤起听众不同的情感反应。
指挥家在整个交响乐中调整速度，以营造戏剧性的张力。

tenant.example: You must be present during that time, as our policy is that only the primary tenant can let the technician in.
tenant.example_cn: 您必须在那段时间在场，因为我们的政策规定只有主要租户才能让技术人员进门。
altExamples: The tenant submitted a formal complaint regarding the inadequate heating system in the apartment.
Every tenant must sign a lease agreement outlining the responsibilities of both parties.
altExamples_cn: 租户就公寓供暖系统不足的问题提交了正式投诉。
每位租户都必须签署一份概述双方责任的租赁协议。

textiles.example: In addition to food, the market sells handmade crafts like jewelry, pottery, and textiles.
textiles.example_cn: 除了食品，市场还出售手工工艺品，如珠宝、陶器和纺织品。
altExamples: The Industrial Revolution transformed textiles production from handcraft to machine-based manufacturing.
Traditional textiles from the region feature intricate patterns passed down through generations of weavers.
altExamples_cn: 工业革命将纺织品生产从手工制作转变为机器制造。
该地区的传统纺织品以代代织工传承下来的精美图案为特色。

texture.example: Because oil paints dry more slowly than tempera paints, artists could use blending and layering to create more texture and richer colors.
texture.example_cn: 由于油画颜料比蛋彩画颜料干得慢，艺术家可以利用调和与叠加创造出更多的质感和更丰富的色彩。
altExamples: The texture of oil paint allows artists to create impasto effects that add dimension to canvases.
Soil texture significantly influences water retention capacity and nutrient availability for plant roots.
altExamples_cn: 油画颜料的质感使艺术家能够创造出厚涂效果，为画布增添立体感。
土壤质地显著影响保水能力和植物根系的养分可用性。

theoretical.example: [D] The theoretical use of sunstones remains a fascinating example of Viking ingenuity.
theoretical.example_cn: 太阳石的理论用途仍然是维京人聪明才智的一个引人入胜的例子。
altExamples: The physicist proposed a theoretical model to explain the anomalous behavior of subatomic particles.
While the concept seems promising in theoretical terms, practical implementation remains challenging.
altExamples_cn: 物理学家提出了一个理论模型来解释亚原子粒子的异常行为。
虽然这一概念在理论上看起来很有前景，但实际实施仍然具有挑战性。

tier.example: This event is a great opportunity to explore our state-of-the-art facility, featuring top-tier equipment, energizing group classes, and expert personal training.
tier.example_cn: 本次活动是参观我们最先进设施的绝佳机会，这里拥有一流设备、充满活力的团体课程和专业的私教训练。
altExamples: Students in the advanced tier of the program undertake independent research projects with faculty mentors.
The company's pricing structure includes a premium tier with access to exclusive features.
altExamples_cn: 高级层次的学生在教师导师的指导下开展独立研究项目。
公司的定价结构包括一个高级层次，可享受专属功能。

tigers.example: (D) In contrast, predators such as lions and tigers can afford longer, deeper sleep because they face fewer threats.
tigers.example_cn: 相比之下，像狮子和老虎这样的掠食者可以享受更长、更深的睡眠，因为它们面临的威胁较少。
altExamples: Conservation efforts have focused on protecting tigers from poaching and habitat destruction.
Unlike domesticated species, tigers retain their instinctual hunting behaviors even in captivity.
altExamples_cn: 保护工作重点是保护老虎免受偷猎和栖息地破坏。
与驯化物种不同，老虎即使在圈养环境中也保留其本能的捕猎行为。

tolman.example: This concept, first proposed by psychologist Edward Tolman in the 1940s, revolutionized the understanding of navigation and spatial awareness.
tolman.example_cn: 这一概念由心理学家 Edward Tolman 在 20 世纪 40 年代首次提出，彻底改变了人们对导航和空间认知的理解。
altExamples: Tolman's experiments with rats demonstrated that learning can occur without immediate reinforcement.
The concept of cognitive maps originated from Tolman's research on spatial navigation in mammals.
altExamples_cn: Tolman 用老鼠进行的实验表明，学习可以在没有即时强化的情况下发生。
认知地图的概念源于 Tolman 对哺乳动物空间导航的研究。

transparent.example: Iceland spar is a transparent variety of calcite that possesses unique optical properties.
transparent.example_cn: 冰洲石是方解石的一种透明变种，具有独特的光学特性。
altExamples: The company pledged to maintain transparent accounting practices to restore investor confidence.
Transparent communication between departments is essential for cross-functional project success.
altExamples_cn: 公司承诺保持透明的会计实践，以恢复投资者信心。
部门之间透明的沟通对于跨职能项目的成功至关重要。

trees.example: In the latter, the illuminated main figures contrast with the deep brown shadows of the rocks and trees in the background.
trees.example_cn: 在后者中，被照亮的主要人物与背景中岩石和树木的深棕色阴影形成对比。
altExamples: Deciduous trees shed their leaves annually to conserve water during the winter months.
Urban trees provide shade, reduce air pollution, and enhance the aesthetic appeal of city streets.
altExamples_cn: 落叶树每年落叶以在冬季保存水分。
城市树木提供阴凉、减少空气污染并提升城市街道的美观度。

triggering.example: Music affects the brain by triggering the release of neurotransmitters such as dopamine and serotonin, which are associated with pleasure and mood regulation.
triggering.example_cn: 音乐通过触发多巴胺和血清素等神经递质的释放来影响大脑，这些神经递质与愉悦感和情绪调节有关。
altExamples: The sudden drop in temperature is triggering early migration patterns among local bird populations.
Certain foods are capable of triggering allergic reactions in individuals with specific sensitivities.
altExamples_cn: 气温的骤降正在引发当地鸟类种群的提前迁徙模式。
某些食物能够引发特定敏感体质个体的过敏反应。

trillions.example: The human microbiome consists of trillions of microorganisms living in and on our bodies.
trillions.example_cn: 人体微生物组由生活在体内和表面的数万亿微生物组成。
altExamples: The human digestive system houses trillions of bacteria that aid in breaking down complex nutrients.
Government budgets are often discussed in terms of trillions of dollars for infrastructure projects.
altExamples_cn: 人体消化系统容纳了数万亿有助于分解复杂营养物质的细菌。
政府预算常常以数万亿美元计用于基础设施项目。

tuberculosis.example: As a result, urban areas became hot spots for diseases such as cholera and tuberculosis.
tuberculosis.example_cn: 结果，城市地区成为霍乱和肺结核等疾病的高发区。
altExamples: Tuberculosis remains a major public health concern in developing countries with limited healthcare infrastructure.
The discovery of antibiotics in the twentieth century dramatically reduced mortality rates from tuberculosis.
altExamples_cn: 在医疗基础设施有限的发展中国家，肺结核仍然是一个主要的公共卫生问题。
二十世纪抗生素的发现大大降低了肺结核的死亡率。

tumors.example: Ancient texts describe procedures like the removal of tumors and the setting of broken bones.
tumors.example_cn: 古代文献描述了诸如切除肿瘤和接骨等手术。
altExamples: Early detection of tumors significantly improves the prognosis for patients undergoing cancer treatment.
Researchers are investigating whether dietary patterns influence the growth rate of malignant tumors.
altExamples_cn: 肿瘤的早期发现显著改善了接受癌症治疗患者的预后。
研究人员正在调查饮食模式是否会影响恶性肿瘤的生长速度。

twentieth.example: (A) In the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, the introduction of film and roll cameras made photography more accessible to the public.
twentieth.example_cn: 在十九世纪末和二十世纪初，胶片和胶卷相机的引入使摄影对公众更加普及。
altExamples: The twentieth century witnessed unprecedented technological advances that transformed everyday life.
Many of the twentieth century's most influential architectural movements emerged in response to urbanization.
altExamples_cn: 二十世纪见证了前所未有的技术进步，这些进步改变了日常生活。
二十世纪许多最具影响力的建筑运动都是为了应对城市化而产生的。

twilight.example: One influential anthology series was The Twilight Zone, which blended science fiction, horror, and drama in thought-provoking ways.
twilight.example_cn: 一部有影响力的选集系列是《迷离时空》，它以发人深省的方式融合了科幻、恐怖和戏剧。
altExamples: During twilight, the fading light creates soft shadows that photographers find especially appealing.
Many nocturnal animals begin their foraging activities precisely at twilight to avoid daytime predators.
altExamples_cn: 黄昏时分，渐暗的光线创造出柔和的阴影，摄影师觉得这特别迷人。
许多夜行动物恰好在黄昏时分开始觅食活动，以避开白天的捕食者。

unaffected.example: As a result, there has been a noticeable increase in Vibrio-related infections in regions previously unaffected.
unaffected.example_cn: 结果，在以前不受影响的地区，与弧菌相关的感染出现了明显增加。
altExamples: The coastal region remained largely unaffected by the economic downturn due to its tourism revenue.
Some plant species appear unaffected by the rising temperatures that threaten other local vegetation.
altExamples_cn: 沿海地区由于旅游收入基本未受经济衰退的影响。
一些植物物种似乎不受威胁其他当地植被的气温上升的影响。

unblocking.example: Treatments focused on unblocking channels using herbal remedies and physical interventions.
unblocking.example_cn: 治疗方法侧重于使用草药和物理干预来疏通经络。
altExamples: The maintenance crew focused on unblocking the drainage system before the heavy rains arrived.
Unblocking the flow of traffic through the tunnel required coordinated efforts from multiple city agencies.
altExamples_cn: 维修人员在暴雨来临前集中精力疏通排水系统。
疏通隧道内的交通流需要多个市政机构的协同努力。

uncover.example: Archaeologists have yet to uncover these stones in the remains of Viking settlements or ships.
uncover.example_cn: 考古学家尚未在维京人定居点或船只的遗迹中发现这些石头。
altExamples: Archaeologists continue to uncover artifacts that shed light on ancient trading routes.
The investigation aims to uncover the underlying causes of the structural failure in the bridge.
altExamples_cn: 考古学家不断发掘出揭示古代贸易路线的文物。
调查旨在揭示桥梁结构失效的根本原因。

undeniably.example: While urbanization presented numerous obstacles, it undeniably laid the groundwork for modern society.
undeniably.example_cn: 虽然城市化带来了诸多障碍，但它无可否认地为现代社会奠定了基础。
altExamples: The artist's influence on contemporary painting is undeniably profound and far-reaching.
Climate change is undeniably one of the most pressing challenges facing the international community.
altExamples_cn: 这位艺术家对当代绘画的影响无疑是深远而广泛的。
气候变化无疑是国际社会面临的最紧迫挑战之一。

undergone.example: Agricultural economics has undergone significant changes, driven by advancements in technology and shifts in consumer demand.
undergone.example_cn: 在技术进步和消费者需求变化的推动下，农业经济学经历了重大变革。
altExamples: The healthcare system has undergone substantial reforms aimed at improving patient access and affordability.
Over the past decade, the downtown district has undergone a remarkable transformation into a cultural hub.
altExamples_cn: 医疗体系经历了旨在改善患者就医可及性和负担能力的实质性改革。
在过去的十年里，市中心经历了一场向文化中心的显著转型。

uneven.example: The jet stream's dynamics are influenced by factors like the Earth's rotation and uneven heating of its surface.
uneven.example_cn: 急流的动态受到地球自转和地表不均匀受热等因素的影响。
altExamples: The uneven distribution of wealth across the population contributes to social and political tensions.
The athlete's performance was uneven throughout the season, fluctuating between brilliance and inconsistency.
altExamples_cn: 财富在人口中的不均衡分配加剧了社会和政治紧张。
该运动员在整个赛季的表现起伏不定，在出色和不稳定之间波动。

unfamiliar.example: Studies involving brain imaging have shown that when people navigate through unfamiliar environments, the hippocampus becomes highly active.
unfamiliar.example_cn: 涉及脑成像的研究表明，当人们在不熟悉的环境中导航时，海马体会变得高度活跃。
altExamples: Students often struggle when confronted with unfamiliar vocabulary in advanced academic texts.
The researcher found herself in unfamiliar territory when her experiments produced unexpected results.
altExamples_cn: 学生在面对高等学术文本中的生词时常常感到吃力。
当实验产生意外结果时，这位研究员发现自己进入了不熟悉的领域。

unify.example: Chanting and singing have been used in protests and rallies to motivate and unify participants.
unify.example_cn: 在抗议和集会中，吟唱和歌唱被用来鼓舞和团结参与者。
altExamples: The new curriculum aims to unify disparate teaching methods into a coherent educational framework.
Effective leaders unify their teams around a shared vision rather than relying on authority alone.
altExamples_cn: 新课程旨在将不同的教学方法统一为一个连贯的教育框架。
高效的领导者围绕共同愿景团结团队，而非仅依靠权威。

unihemispheric.example: Dolphins practice unihemispheric slow-wave sleep, meaning one half of their brain sleeps while the other remains awake.
unihemispheric.example_cn: 海豚采用单半球慢波睡眠，这意味着它们的大脑一半在睡觉，另一半保持清醒。
altExamples: Unihemispheric sleep allows certain aquatic mammals to surface for air while resting.
The evolutionary advantage of unihemispheric sleep lies in maintaining continuous environmental awareness.
altExamples_cn: 单半球睡眠使某些水生哺乳动物能够在休息时浮出水面换气。
单半球睡眠的进化优势在于能够保持对环境的持续警觉。

upbeat.example: This is why workout playlists often feature upbeat songs, while relaxation playlists include soothing melodies.
upbeat.example_cn: 这就是为什么运动歌单通常收录欢快的歌曲，而放松歌单则包含舒缓的旋律。
altExamples: The upbeat economic report suggested that consumer confidence was finally beginning to recover.
Music therapists often employ upbeat rhythms to help patients improve their motor coordination.
altExamples_cn: 乐观的经济报告表明，消费者信心终于开始恢复。
音乐治疗师常常使用欢快的节奏来帮助患者改善运动协调能力。

update.example: The deadline for the software update is tomorrow.
update.example_cn: 软件更新的截止日期是明天。
altExamples: The annual update to the curriculum reflects the most recent developments in each academic field and discipline.
Regular progress updates are essential for maintaining transparency with project stakeholders and funding agencies.
altExamples_cn: 课程的年度更新反映了每个学术领域和学科的最新发展。
定期的进度更新对于保持与项目利益相关者和资助机构的透明度至关重要。

upgrade.example: This essential work is part of our seasonal inspection and efficiency upgrade initiative to ensure optimal performance during the colder months.
upgrade.example_cn: 这项必要工作是我们季节性检查和效率升级计划的一部分，旨在确保在寒冷月份的最佳性能。
altExamples: The university plans to upgrade its laboratory facilities to meet modern research standards.
Passengers can upgrade their tickets to business class for an additional fee at check-in.
altExamples_cn: 大学计划升级其实验室设施，以达到现代研究标准。
乘客可以在办理登机手续时额外付费将机票升级到商务舱。

username.example: username：Sofia Baker Every Saturday, our local farmer's market is the place to be!
username.example_cn: 用户名：Sofia Baker  每周六，我们当地的农贸市场是最值得去的地方！
altExamples: Each student receives a unique username and password for accessing the online library system.
The system requires that your username contain at least eight characters including letters and numbers.
altExamples_cn: 每位学生都会收到一个唯一的用户名和密码，用于访问在线图书馆系统。
系统要求用户名至少包含八个字符，包括字母和数字。

utilizes.example: Precision farming utilizes satellite imagery to enhance crop yields by analyzing soil and weather conditions.
utilizes.example_cn: 精准农业利用卫星图像通过分析土壤和天气条件来提高作物产量。
altExamples: The new software utilizes machine learning algorithms to predict consumer purchasing patterns.
This teaching method utilizes interactive exercises to reinforce concepts covered in lectures.
altExamples_cn: 新软件利用机器学习算法来预测消费者购买模式。
这种教学方法利用互动练习来巩固讲座中涵盖的概念。

validated.example: Modern science has validated some ancient remedies; for example, willow bark contains salicin, a precursor to aspirin, with pain-relieving properties.
validated.example_cn: 现代科学已经验证了一些古老的疗法；例如，柳树皮含有水杨苷，它是阿司匹林的前体，具有止痛作用。
altExamples: The hypothesis was validated through a series of controlled experiments conducted over two years.
Peer review ensures that scientific claims are validated before being published in reputable journals.
altExamples_cn: 该假说通过为期两年的一系列对照实验得到了验证。
同行评审确保科学论断在知名期刊上发表之前经过验证。

vanishing.example: Artists created the illusion of depth by using vanishing points on horizon lines, which are points in the background where parallel lines converge.
vanishing.example_cn: 艺术家通过在地平线上使用消失点来创造深度幻觉，消失点是背景中平行线汇聚的点。
altExamples: The vanishing Arctic ice cap poses a significant threat to polar bear populations worldwide.
Indigenous languages are vanishing at an alarming rate, taking with them unique cultural knowledge.
altExamples_cn: 正在消失的北极冰盖对全球北极熊的数量构成重大威胁。
原住民语言正以惊人的速度消失，随之带走了独特的文化知识。

vegan.example: Don't miss the bakery stall—get there early for the best bread and pastries, including gluten-free and vegan options.
vegan.example_cn: 别错过面包摊位——早点去抢最好的面包和糕点，包括无麸质和纯素选择。
altExamples: The university cafeteria now offers a dedicated vegan station to accommodate growing student demand.
Adopting a vegan lifestyle can significantly reduce an individual's carbon footprint according to recent studies.
altExamples_cn: 大学食堂现在设有专门的纯素餐台，以满足日益增长的学生需求。
根据最近的研究，采用纯素生活方式可以显著减少个人的碳足迹。

vegetables.example: Their stall is always bustling with customers eager to buy fresh, pesticide-free vegetables from the welcoming staff.
vegetables.example_cn: 他们的摊位总是熙熙攘攘，顾客热切地从热情的员工那里购买新鲜、无农药的蔬菜。
altExamples: Root vegetables such as carrots and potatoes store nutrients that sustain them through winter.
The nutritional content of vegetables can diminish significantly if they are overcooked or overprocessed.
altExamples_cn: 胡萝卜和土豆等根茎类蔬菜储存养分，使其能够度过冬天。
如果过度烹饪或过度加工，蔬菜的营养成分会显著降低。
